verdict.rationale: Greenhouse's reporting product explicitly supports building recruiting reports by candidates, sources, departments, jobs, offers, and openings, with boolean/multilayer filtering and AI-powered report filters, which covers stage conversion, source effectiveness, and offer data. However, there's no direct evidence of dedicated time-to-hire or offer-accept-rate dashboards per role/team, or of founder-level rollups across teams. Missing for 10: explicit time-to-hire metric documentation, offer-accept-rate reporting specifics, and independent/hands-on validation of report accuracy or per-team breakdowns.
